effect.name: GM Pixel Reveal
effect.desc: Reveals or hides the layer through a pixel-block dissolve, and it is a real reveal - the unrevealed area is transparent, so whatever sits underneath shows through. Six orders: a random per-block dissolve, a directional block wipe, a mosaic that grows from a centre point, coarse random tiles, a checkerboard sweep, and fine scan lines. Progress is a manual control or can be animated on its own, block size and direction are independent, and randomness blends the wipe order between perfectly regular and completely scattered. There is an edge glow on the reveal frontier, a mosaic stage so the revealed area can pass through a pixelated look first, and a choice of what the hidden area shows. Layer space, so the blocks are cut from the layer.
